en.headline: Veteran actor and dancer Lau Siu-ming dies at 94
en.dek: Friend and actor Ding Yu said Ming Sir died on Wednesday evening; Culture Secretary Rosanna Law praised his work in dance and film.
body: Veteran Hong Kong actor and dancer Lau Siu-ming, known in the industry as Ming Sir, died on Wednesday evening at the age of 94, fellow performer Ding Yu confirmed.

Lau trained in dance in France before returning to Hong Kong, where he was regarded as one of the pioneers of local dance and later moved into film and television. He appeared in Tsui Hark’s Butterfly Murder and became widely known for playing the tree demon Granny in A Chinese Ghost Story, as well as for long-running television roles after joining TVB. His last screen credit was the 2020 ViuTV drama Bridge of Memories.

He received an honorary fellowship from the Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts in 2007, the Medal of Honour in 2013 and TVB’s Lifetime Achievement Award the same year. In later years he used a wheelchair and made few public appearances; one of his last was at a cultural sector National Day reception last October.

Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law said the bureau offered condolences to his family. “Ming Sir devoted his life to dance and the performing arts. We will remember his talent and dedication,” she said, adding that the government paid the highest respect to his artistic achievements.

zh.headline: 資深演員及舞蹈家劉兆銘逝世 享年94歲
zh.dek: 藝人丁羽證實Ming Sir周三傍晚離世；文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩向其家人致哀，稱會銘記他的才華與奉獻。
body: 資深演員及舞蹈家劉兆銘（行內稱Ming Sir）周三傍晚逝世，享年94歲，消息由藝人丁羽證實。
劉兆銘早年赴法國習舞，回港後被視為本港舞蹈開拓者之一，其後投身電影及電視。他曾演出徐克《蝶變》，並因《倩女幽魂》樹妖婆婆一角廣為人知，加入無網後演出多部劇集。他最後一部幕前作品為2020年ViuTV劇集《歎息橋》。
他於2007年獲香港演藝學院頒授榮譽院士，2013年獲特區政府頒發榮譽勳章，同年獲萬千光輝演藝人大獎。晚年因健康問題需以輪椅代步，較少公開露面，去年10月曾出席文化藝術界國慶酒會。
文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩向其家人致以慰問。她表示，Ming Sir畢生致力於舞蹈及演藝事業，當局會銘記他的才華與奉獻精神，並向其卓越藝術成就致以最高敬意。
